name: @huddle/ui
description: Boardwalk design system: the only place in Huddle that holds colors, type, and shadow tokens.
//exports: The root entry is tokens only and imports nothing from React — and, since the screens task, no font binaries either — which is what keeps it runnable under plain Node. That matters beyond this package's own tests: a Game Module's screens import these tokens, so anything the root barrel drags is dragged into every Node test that touches the Registry. Components live behind `./native`, whose react-native import resolves to whichever variant the consuming app installed — react-native-tvos on the TV, stock on the phone — which is exactly why it is a peer dependency. `./fonts` is the four .ttf assets, which only the apps' root layouts load.
